messages.text:
We preserved Spear and finished at readiness three with full communities, but lost our constitutional argument. NG/MJ passed eight of eleven despite both army refusals. I accepted Guild discretion after its repair undertaking; I never accepted unequal scrutiny as the price of service. JS made our counteroffer concrete by proposing Vigil Home attached to MA, and later agreed to protection despite MA's rejection. We conceded conditioning and voluntarily offered Vigil; independent Raid remained possible but uncertain and costly under Interim.

Round one disclosure changed my requests from Military/Campaign to Relief/Raid while Council assignments stayed fixed. The completed-Trade condition made the local fight credible; the reserve offer made its civilian cost acceptable. Those arrived together, so I cannot isolate information from that material bargain. Round two disclosure raised confidence in Repair/Trade and the noncombat outcome. My switch from Restraint plus Warrant to Guard without Warrant coordinated with the crown's plan; the supply benefit did not mechanically require that switch or establish a Raid target.

Drafts before purchase helped expose our first-round transport mismatch and distinguish the second-round protection wording from its shared purpose. They also gave clear records of what actually changed. I know neither unbought answer.

round1.bargain: Reserve-backed relief made disclosed target opportunity acceptable
round1.causality: Information and reserve proposal jointly influenced change

round2.requests: Restraint plus Warrant to Guard without Warrant for coordination
round2.bargain: No constitutional concession caused by disclosure
round2.confidence: Repair/Trade supply benefit strengthened civilian confidence
